headline: X Energy Stock Surges on Fluor Partnership for Washington SMR
summary: X Energy shares surged following a partnership announcement with Fluor to develop a Small Modular Reactor (SMR) in Washington.
why: Strategic partnerships in the nuclear and clean energy sectors validate technology pipelines and project commercialization potential.
